securityModal.subtitle: Please read carefully before starting

tips.title: Never Share OTPs or Passwords
tips.desc: Our experts will NEVER ask for OTPs, passwords, bank PINs, or CVV numbers. If anyone asks, report immediately.

tips.title: Beware of External Links
tips.desc: Do not click on any suspicious links shared during the chat. All payments are processed securely within our platform only.

tips.title: Payment Security
tips.desc: Never make payments outside our official platform. All transactions are encrypted and protected by our secure payment gateway.

tips.title: Personal Information
tips.desc: Avoid sharing sensitive personal details like Aadhaar, PAN, or credit card numbers. Only share astrological information.

tips.title: Do Not Share Contact Details
tips.desc: NEVER share your mobile number, email, WhatsApp, or any social media handles with the expert. All communication must happen only on our platform.

tips.title: No Direct Contact Outside Platform
tips.desc: Do NOT contact experts directly outside this platform. If you do so and face any issues, Astrology in Bharat will NOT be responsible or liable.

tips.title: Report Suspicious Activity
tips.desc: If you notice any unusual behavior or requests, immediately end the session and contact our support team.

tips.title: Verified Experts Only
tips.desc: All our experts are verified professionals. However, use your judgment and stay alert during consultations.
